title: T46 agent-core: animated tier — pack checks + tier on /avatars (0.7.26)
head: t46-animated-tier
body:
**needs Braden** -- signed index shape change (`parse_index` gains an optional per-pack `tier` key), same signature-checked path as the T22 follow-up PR (decision #80).

## What

agent-core's half of T46 (animated tier for avatar packs), per `docs/t46/contract.md` §1/§2/§3/§5/§7/§8 (§8 item 7's 8-idle-variant cap included, added mid-review per the coordinator).

- `src/anorak/avatar_pack.py` (the validator shared with playbooks' `validate_pack`, no second copy): three new, all-optional top-level manifest keys -- `tier` (`"standard"`/`"animated"`, absent means `"standard"`, any other value refused), `frames` (4-12, must equal `grid.columns`) and `fps` (6-12, must equal `grid.fps`, kept separate from `grid.fps`'s own existing 1-12 check) -- plus up to 8 extra `grid.rows` entries after the fixed eight states (`idle_variant_1`...`idle_variant_8`, numbered from 1 with no gaps, then an optional trailing `celebrate`; a 9th `idle_variant_N`, a gap, `celebrate` out of place or an unknown name are all refused). `tier: animated` is refused outright without at least one `idle_variant_N` row **and** a `celebrate` row. Every new rule reuses the existing `"grid"` error code (no new `PackErrorCode` value), matching paths `tier`/`frames`/`fps`/`grid.rows` per §3. An old pack (none of these keys) validates byte-for-byte exactly as before. New `manifest_tier()` reads a validated manifest's own tier for callers. The sheet-shape guess fed to the shared PNG decoder now follows the manifest's own `grid.columns`/`grid.rows`, clamped to a small fixed bound (12 columns, 32 rows) so a hostile manifest can never widen the decompression-bomb guard past a small multiple of the real maximum legal shape -- the fixed 512x1024/2 MB case is unaffected.
- `src/anorak/avatar_library.py`: the signed library index's per-pack entry (`LibraryPack`) gains an optional `tier` (same optional-key mechanism as `category`; missing means `"standard"`). `_passes_load_check` now also re-derives the tier from the loaded, already-validated manifest (`manifest_tier`) and refuses the pack -- exactly like a sha256/size mismatch (`_mark_tampered`, not listed as installed) -- if it no longer agrees with what the pack's own cached signed index declared (contract §8 item 1). `list_packs()` reports the installed manifest's own tier once installed, else the (stored-index's) declared tier for an un-downloaded row, so a tile can show "More motion" before download. New `AvatarLibrary.pack_tier()` resolves one id's tier (installed library pack, else drawer pack, else `"standard"`) for callers that only have an id.
- `src/anorak/avatars.py`: bundled `AvatarPack` TypedDict gains `tier`; both bundled rows (Beacon, the dev-only Test block) are `"standard"`.
- `src/anorak/local_service.py`: `tier` is now on every `GET /avatars` row (via the two sources above), `GET`/`PUT /avatar`'s reply, the kept blocking `POST /avatars/:id/install`'s reply, and the `avatar.changed` broadcast (new `LocalService._pack_tier`, `AvatarLibraryRuntime.pack_tier` added to the structural seam). Scope call: I read contract §5's "every installed/selected-avatar response the app reads" as those four, not the async install-job snapshot (`GET`/`POST`/`DELETE .../install-job`), which stays a progress/status object with no `tier` key -- the desktop app already gets an id's tier from the next `GET /avatars` poll or the `avatar.changed` broadcast; flag if the Rig build wants it on the job snapshot too.
- `docs/local-service.md`: documents the new `tier` field on every route above and the animated-tier manifest shape, cross-referenced to `docs/formats.md`/`docs/t46/contract.md`.
- Version 0.7.25 -> 0.7.26 in `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`'s own `agent-core` package entry, `ServiceRuntime.version`, `anorak.__version__`, and the two other places this repo already pins its own version string alongside it (`chat_service.py`'s `skill_version="0.7.25"` x2 for the `rig-chat` skill-run audit identity, `local_service_adapters.py`'s summarizer `Skill(version=...)`) -- found by `grep -rn "0\.7\.25"` before editing. `CHANGELOG.md` gets a new `## 0.7.26` entry.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

Mutant -> killing test (all applied by editing source, run under `pytest`, then reverted by re-applying my own edit -- never `git checkout`/`git restore`/`git stash`; WIP committed first, squashed into this one commit after):

| # | Mutant | Killing test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Accept an out-of-range `frames`/`fps` at load-check time (drop both range checks in `_frames_ok`/`_fps_ok`, keeping only the `grid.columns`/`grid.fps` equality check) | `test_frames_matching_columns_but_out_of_range_is_refused`, `test_fps_matching_grid_fps_but_out_of_range_is_refused` (each isolates the range check from the separate equality check) |
| 2 | Report `tier: "animated"` for a pack whose manifest carries no `tier` (`manifest_tier` always returns `"animated"`) | `test_old_pack_with_no_animated_keys_is_unaffected` (asserts `manifest_tier(...) == "standard"`; 24 more tests failed downstream once every standard pack started tripping the new index/manifest tier check) |
| (a) | Ignore an index/manifest `tier` mismatch (drop the `tier != entry.tier` check in `_passes_load_check`) | `test_installed_tier_differing_from_signed_index_is_tampered` |
| (b) | Accept `tier: animated` without a `celebrate` row (drop `_CELEBRATE_ROW not in tail` from the animated-tier requirement check) | `test_animated_tier_missing_celebrate_is_refused` |
| (c) | Accept a 9th (or later) `idle_variant_N` row (drop the §8 item 7 cap from `_valid_row_tail`'s loop condition) | `test_a_ninth_idle_variant_is_refused` |

All 5 mutants killed; no survivors. `ruff check`/`ruff format --check`/`mypy --strict` re-run clean after every restore.

New/changed tests: `tests/test_avatar_pack.py` (animated pack with 1/2/8 idle variants + celebrate passes; old pack unaffected; invalid `tier` values; `frames`/`fps` out of range, wrong type, and mismatched-with-`grid` cases, including the two isolated out-of-range-but-matching cases the mutation check needed; animated tier missing `idle_variant_1` and/or `celebrate`; gap in numbering, `celebrate` not last, unknown row name; extra rows refused without the animated tier; a 9th idle variant refused); `tests/test_avatar_library.py` (drawer pack with out-of-range animated fields not listed; an un-installed row shows the signed index's own declared tier; an installed animated pack lists with a matching tier and `pack_tier()`/`install()` agree; installed tier differing from the pack's own cached signed index is tampered -- not served, not listed installed, one `avatar_cache_refused` line, sha256/size/signature checks on other pack files untouched to isolate this one new check); every existing row/response-shape assertion across `tests/test_avatars.py`, `tests/test_avatar_library.py`, `tests/test_avatar_install_jobs.py`, `tests/test_service_cli.py`, `tests/test_local_service.py` updated for the new `tier` field.
